hero.quote: "The only PGA-certified golf course in Vietnam, designed by Greg Norman with magnificent views of the Phan Thiet coastline."

overviewParagraphs: Located within the expansive NovaWorld Phan Thiet resort, the PGA Ocean Course is a crowning achievement in Vietnam's growing golf portfolio. Greg Norman has masterfully utilized the natural contours of the land, creating a layout that is both visually stunning and strategically demanding. The course is defined by its pristine Zoysia grass fairways, rugged bunkering, and sweeping ocean vistas. As a PGA-branded property, it meets the highest international standards, ready to host top-tier professional tournaments while remaining accessible and enjoyable for amateur players. The world-class amenities, including a premier academy and an opulent clubhouse, ensure an unparalleled golf experience from arrival to departure.

curatorBriefHtml: PGA Ocean Course at NovaWorld Phan Thiet (opened 2021) is Vietnam’s only PGA-branded championship facility — a sweeping 7,400-yard Par 72 Greg Norman layout perched high above Phan Thiet Bay. Dressed wall-to-wall in crisp Zeon Zoysia fairways and Primo Zoysia greens, the course stretches across bold coastal ridges with panoramic East Sea vistas on nearly every hole and massive rugged waste bunkers demanding accurate tee placement.

Alongside its sister 18-hole PGA Garden Course (also by Greg Norman), NovaWorld turns Phan Thiet / Mui Ne into a serious 36-hole coastal golf hub — now just 2 hours 15 minutes from Ho Chi Minh City thanks to the Dau Giay–Phan Thiet Expressway (slashing the old 5-hour drive in half!).

Phan Thiet’s arid coastal micro-climate stays dry and breezy almost year-round, allowing AGS to build effortless southern coastal loops pairing PGA Ocean Course with nearby Sea Links Golf Club and The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram.

scorecard.gradeBadge: PGA Tour Certified Standards • Greg Norman
scorecard.verdict: Officially certified by the PGA of America, this Greg Norman layout offers rolling fairways, dramatic ocean views, and rugged bunkers reminiscent of the Australian Sandbelt.

faqs.q: How long is the drive from Ho Chi Minh City to PGA Ocean Course Phan Thiet now?
faqs.a: Thanks to the Dau Giay–Phan Thiet Expressway, private touring vehicles now reach PGA Ocean Course in roughly 2 hours 15 minutes to 2 hours 30 minutes from central Ho Chi Minh City — half the old travel time.

faqs.q: What makes PGA Ocean Course different from PGA Garden Course at NovaWorld?
faqs.a: Both were designed by Greg Norman, but the PGA Ocean Course is the longer, bolder coastal links-style championship centerpiece overlooking the sea, while the PGA Garden Course plays slightly more sheltered with parkland water hazards and resort playability.

faqs.q: How does Phan Thiet wind affect play at PGA Ocean Course?
faqs.a: Phan Thiet is Vietnam’s wind-sports capital, so steady ocean breezes are part of the fun — especially after midday. Booking a morning 07:30–08:45 AM tee time gives calmer air and crisp Zeon Zoysia lies.

faqs.q: Can we combine PGA Ocean Course with The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram?
faqs.a: Yes — driving along the southern coast from Ho Tram up to Phan Thiet takes about 90 minutes, creating an epic Greg Norman coastal links double-header.
